request.initial_prompt: Yes, I said, he lives from day to day indulging the appetite of the hour; and sometimes he is lapped in drink and strains of the flute; then he becomes a water-drinker, and tries to get thin; then he takes a turn at gymnastics; sometimes idling and neglecting everything, then once more living the life of a philosopher; often he is busy with politics, and starts to his feet and says and does whatever comes into his head; and, if he is emulous of any one who is a warrior, off he is in that direction, or of men of business, once more in that. His life has neither law nor order; and this distracted existence he terms joy and bliss and freedom; and so he goes on.

raw_segments.text: Yes, I said, he lives from day to day indulging the appetite of the hour, and sometimes he
is lapped in drink and strains of the flute, then he becomes a water-drinker, and tries
to get thin, then he takes a turn at gymnastics, sometimes idling and neglecting everything,
then once more living the life of a philosopher, often he is busy with politics, and starts
to his feet and says and does whatever comes into his head.
And, if he is emulous of any one who is a warrior, off he is in that direction, or of
men of business, once more in that. His life has neither law nor order, and this distracted
existence he terms joy and bliss and freedom, and so he goes on.
